newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.127.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.127.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Friday said the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 30.127 against 30.062 per dollar on Thursday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 30.12/30.22 to the dollar onshore and 30.05/30.15 in the offshore market early.
